documents.title: Engineering Execution Plan and Deliverables List

sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
paragraphs: This Engineering Execution Plan (EEP) defines how Helios EPC LLC (HEP) will carry out and control the engineering of the HELIOS 100 MWac / 128 MWp Solar PV and 50 MW / 100 MWh BESS Power Plant (HEL001) from Notice to Proceed (15 December 2026) to As-Built issue. It is the engineering input to the Level 1-3 baseline schedule (A040) and to the design submission item agreed at the Kick-off Meeting (HEL001-MOM-KOM-001).

Scope covers: PV blocks PV1-PV4 (single-axis trackers, 620 Wp TOPCon bifacial modules, 28 central inverter stations of 3.6 MVA), BESS, 33 kV MV collection, 33/220 kV plant substation (PSS), grid substation interface (GSS), 9 km 220 kV OHTL (TL1), and site civil and infrastructure (SIT). This revision is Rev A for internal use and for information to QSE and Meridian; durations flagged as indicative are subject to confirmation under ACT-002-KOM-05 by 8 December 2026.

sections.heading: 2. Engineering Organisation and Responsibilities
paragraphs: I am accountable for the design basis, drawings, calculations, technical specifications, design review responses and technical queries, and for design change control. Interfaces are managed as follows.

rows: Design basis, issue and review cycle
Owner of design basis, deliverables list and design change control
Aziz Karimov, Priya Nair, Dilnoza Rashidova
Deliverables list, durations and logic ties to A040
Thomas Becker (Contracts) with Navoi Regional Administration / State Construction Inspectorate (Shavkat Bobojonov)
Design packages and drawings for the Construction Permit (M07)
Mehmet Yildiz, Li Wei, vendors (SunPeak, VoltEdge, AxisTrack, CellCore)
Technical review of vendor drawings, datasheets, FAT documents
Grid connection technical conditions, protection coordination, energisation documents
Constructability review, TQ response, as-built markups

sections.heading: 3. Design Stages and Review Periods
paragraphs: Design is issued in three stages: Stage 1 Design Basis and Concept; Stage 2 Basic Design (permit and approval level); Stage 3 Detailed Design (Issued for Construction, IFC), followed by as-built. The review periods below are HEP's proposal for the OWE review agreed in principle at KOM and are to be confirmed against the Contract review clause by Thomas Becker. Review of a submission starts only when the complete package and transmittal are received through the EDMS.

rows: Rolling, 4 weeks before the related construction start

sections.heading: 4. Design Inputs and Dependencies
paragraphs: Engineering depends on survey and ground data that are not yet available. Design Basis Report A310 (15 December 2026 to 20 January 2027) will therefore be issued with stated assumptions and revised once the topographic survey (A210, to 25 January 2027) and geotechnical report (A220, to 20 February 2027) are complete.
bullets: Topographic survey (A210): required for grading, drainage, track and cable route layouts; early partial release of PV1 area data requested.

Geotechnical report (A220): required for pile design, tracker foundations, inverter station and substation foundations; pile load test programme to be defined ahead of first piles (M08, 12 April 2027).
Grid connection technical conditions from UzGridCo: required for the 220 kV scheme, protection and metering design; request to be made through Rajan Iyer and Thomas Becker.
Vendor data: module, inverter, tracker and BESS datasheets and interface drawings from the vendors, consistent with the procurement plan (module supply contract M06, 15 February 2027).
Applicable codes: Uzbek construction norms (ShNK/KMK), IEC standards for PV, inverter and BESS equipment, and the Employer's Requirements; the code list is part of the Design Basis.

sections.heading: 5. Deliverables List - Summary by Package
paragraphs: The deliverables are grouped by WBS package. Quantities are indicative document counts for the baseline and will be replaced by the numbered register once the first design document register is issued under ACT-002-KOM-05. All dates are indicative and unapproved.

rows: Design Basis Report, codes, load and climate data
Site layout, civil, grading, drainage, roads, fencing
PV block design PV1-PV4: layout, tracker foundations, DC and string design, earthing
Inverter stations and 33 kV MV collection network
BESS: layout, foundations, PCS and AC/DC design, EMS and fire strategy
220 kV plant substation 33/220 kV: single line, layout, protection, civil, earthing, SCADA
220 kV OHTL 9 km: route survey, tower schedule, foundations, stringing
Calculations: yield, short-circuit, cable sizing, earthing, lightning, voltage drop, structural
Technical specifications and vendor document review

sections.heading: 6. Packages Required for the Construction Permit File
paragraphs: For the Construction Permit (M07, 20 March 2027) the permit file requires the Basic Design set at Stage 2 level, not IFC drawings. The proposed content is listed below. The indicative sequence is Basic Design package complete for internal check by 5 February 2027, issue to OWE 12 February 2027, OWE review to 26 February, comment close-out by 12 March, and Basic Design approval (M04) on 15 March 2027. This leaves five days to M07, which is tight: I recommend that Thomas Becker confirm with Shavkat Bobojonov whether the permit file can be submitted in parallel with OWE review and whether state expertise will accept the file before M04. Final dates will be sent under ACT-002-KOM-05 by 8 December.
bullets: Explanatory note and Design Basis summary (ENG-01).
Master plan and site layout, access road, utilities and grading concept (ENG-02).
PV layout PV1-PV4, DC, MV and 220 kV single line diagrams, BESS layout (ENG-03, ENG-04, ENG-05).
Plant substation layout, single line diagram and protection concept; OHTL route plan and tower schedule (ENG-06, ENG-08).
Structural and foundation concept based on A220 data, fire protection and environmental sections (ENG-02, ENG-05).
Calculations summary: short-circuit, earthing, structural concept (ENG-10).

sections.heading: 7. Document Control, Numbering and Change Control
paragraphs: All deliverables are registered in the EDMS before work starts, using the numbering scheme HEL001-AREA-DISC-TYPE-NNNNN-REV per the Document Control and Numbering Procedure. Revision A is used for issue for review, and numeric revisions for approved issues. Transmittals go through Nilufar Yusupova.

Design changes after approval of the Design Basis follow a design change request: description, reason, drawings affected, cost and schedule impact, my technical approval and Rajan Iyer's approval before any client notification. Any change that could affect the Employer's Requirements, guaranteed values or the permit set is raised with Thomas Becker before implementation. Technical Queries from site are logged and answered within 3 working days for urgent items and 7 working days otherwise.

sections.heading: 8. Quality and Engineering Controls
paragraphs: Each deliverable has an originator, checker and approver. Calculations are independently checked; drawings are checked for coordination across disciplines before issue. Arun Pillai will audit engineering compliance with this plan at Stage 2 and at the first IFC release. Vendor documents are reviewed against the technical specification and returned with status codes within the review periods in section 3.

sections.heading: 9. Key Risks, Assumptions and Next Steps
paragraphs: Main risks: late survey and geotechnical data delaying pile and foundation design; late grid technical conditions; the tight sequence between Basic Design approval and permit; and vendor data arriving after module and inverter contract signature. Mitigation is early data requests, assumption-based design with hold flags, and weekly engineering coordination with the Planning team.

emails.subject: Engineering WBS and deliverables list input for baseline schedule
emails.body:
Aziz,

Please find the engineering WBS and deliverables list input for the L1-L3 baseline (A040), issued today in the Engineering Execution Plan and Deliverables List (3_Design_and_Engineering/02_Design_Basis, Rev A). It answers REQ-000-epc-plan and REQ-002-epc-plan in part.

WBS packages (indicative documents): ENG-01 Design Basis (4); ENG-02 Site civil and infrastructure (45); ENG-03 PV blocks PV1-PV4 (120); ENG-04 Inverter stations and 33 kV MV (70); ENG-05 BESS (55); ENG-06 220 kV plant substation (95); ENG-07 Grid substation interface (25); ENG-08 220 kV OHTL (50); ENG-09 SCADA and telecom (30); ENG-10 Calculations (60); ENG-11 Specifications and vendor document review (40).

Review cycle assumptions: Design Basis Report A310 is 5 working days internal check, 10 calendar days OWE review, 5 working days close-out. Basic Design (M04) is 10 working days internal, 14 calendar days OWE review, 10 working days close-out, approval target 15 March 2027. IFC packages are 5 working days internal, 10 calendar days OWE review, 5 working days close-out, rolling, finishing 4 weeks before the related construction start. Vendor documents are 3 working days internal, 7 calendar days OWE review. These review periods are my proposal and are still to be confirmed against the Contract by Thomas.

Logic ties: A310 follows NTP; Basic Design needs A210 topographic survey (to 25 Jan 2027) and A220 geotechnical report (to 20 Feb 2027), so the Basic Design must be issued on stated assumptions with hold flags for the geotechnical data. IFC foundation and pile packages must precede M08 first piles (12 April 2027); PSS packages must support M10 (20 January 2028).

Durations and dates for the permit-file design packages are indicative only. I will confirm them under ACT-002-KOM-05 by 8 December, and I will then send the first design document register. Please treat the dates in the plan as planning placeholders until then.

Regards,
Elena Petrova
Engineering Manager, HEP

emails.subject: Construction permit file - design packages and indicative timing
emails.body:
Thomas,

In answer to REQ-001-epc-cont and REQ-002-epc-cont, the construction permit file needs the Basic Design (Stage 2) set, not IFC drawings: explanatory note and Design Basis summary, master plan and site layout, PV layout PV1-PV4, DC/MV/220 kV single line diagrams, BESS layout, plant substation layout and protection concept, OHTL route plan and tower schedule, structural and foundation concept, fire and environmental sections, and a calculations summary. Section 6 of the Engineering Execution Plan (3/02, Rev A) gives the list.

Indicative dates: Basic Design to OWE 12 February 2027, OWE review to 26 February, close-out by 12 March, approval M04 on 15 March. M07 is 20 March, so there are only five days after approval. Please check with Shavkat Bobojonov whether the permit file can be lodged in parallel with OWE review, and which standards or expertise the authority applies. These dates are indicative; I will confirm the packages and durations by 8 December under ACT-002-KOM-05. Please also confirm the review periods against the Contract clause.

Regards,
Elena
